recommendationScope: Receipt.AI current constrained qualitative-advice pipeline on approximately 8 GB CPU-only computers; not a universal ranking of the models.
rationale: Similar routine advice, lower latency/RSS and fewer first-pass rejections. 4B delivers more final explanations but includes accepted transport-constraint violations and no clear routine-advice improvement.
configurability: No model ID is hardcoded into production: load another GGUF in llama-server; adapter auto-discovers the loaded model or accepts options.model.
